title: I’m making a match-3 roguelite called Crownfall, would love some honest playtest feedback
author: pixels_that
selftext:
Hey everyone! I’m making **Crownfall**, a tactical match-3 roguelite designed for mobile but I may plan on doing a steam release if its popular. Match jewels to attack, defend, heal, and build your way toward the Crown Dragon.

For transparency, I used **GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5 to help write the code**. Art was done by pixellab. 

It’s currently a free browser playtest, and I’d especially love feedback from people trying it on their phones and computers. 

[Try Crownfall here](https://xedd.itch.io/crownfall): portrait mode recommended. Please mention your phone and browser if something breaks. Thanks for trying it!
